lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := not_forall.1 (funext_iff.mp h)
  have hpos : 0 < ‖f x₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx₀
  have hcont : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := Continuous.inner' hf continuous_const
  have hopen : IsOpen {x | 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ} := hcont.isOpen_gt {0}
  have hx₀_in : x₀ ∈ {x | 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ} := by simp [hpos]
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ_test, hφ_nonneg, hφ_pos, hφ_supp⟩ :=
    exists_testFunction_pos_of_open_subset hopen hx₀_in
  let g : Y → V := fun x => φ x • f x₀
  have hg_test : IsTestFunction g := IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ_test continuous_const
  have key := hg g hg_test
  simp only [g, inner_smul_right'] at key
  have h_integrable : Integrable (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ := by
    apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    · exact Continuous.mul hφ_test.smooth.continuous (Continuous.inner' hf continuous_const)
    · exact hφ_test.supp
  have h_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x; exact mul_nonneg hφ_nonneg x (by
      by_cases hx : x ∈ {x | 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ}
      · exact le_of_lt (Set.mem_setOf.mp hx)
      · rw [not_mem_setOf_eq at hx]; linarith)
  have h_integral_pos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos
    · exact h_nonneg
    · exact hopen.measure_pos (Set.nonempty_of_mem hx₀_in)
    · intro x hx; exact mul_pos (hφ_pos x hx) (Set.mem_setOf.mp hx)
    · exact h_integrable
  linarith
